about.title: About the Club
about.lede: The story, the vision and the people behind Basmat-Muhandis.
about.visionBody: To be a leading student engineering community that inspires innovation, nurtures talent, and bridges the gap between academic learning and real-world engineering challenges.
about.missionBody: To empower students through hands-on projects, workshops and competitions in robotics, programming and electronics — building skills that last a lifetime.
